$comment: Allowlist portability ratchet, read by scripts/checks/portability.ts (#116). The list was seeded from epic #112's evidence and the existing desktop KNOWN_COMMANDS denylist (scripts/checks/desktop-platform.ts). #114 decided: sort, uniq, stat, file, egrep and rg retired outright (no stage used them); find, grep, ls, mkdir, pwd and wc kept pending #295, which owns amending it further. A classification is always about the leading token of a Bash(...) allowlist entry. 'pending' is a ratchet: each entry names a file and the nonPortable tokens its allowlist actually carries today, seeded from the tree at implementation time; any new non-portable entry not already pending fails now, and any pending token #295 removes must be dropped from here in the same commit or the stale-pending rule fails.
